evidence: gpt-oss-120b uses "T = 1 << t" and terminal-mask DP; deepseek-v4-flash constructs pairwise distances with "Floyd-Warshall". Both treat activated differences as graph edges whose connectivity forces equality.
affordance_in_statement: Each functional is defined by a pair of indices (u, v) and maps any vector x to x_u - x_v ... their joint kernel ... is a subspace of the kernel of x ↦ x_a - x_b.
removal_suggestion: No semantics-preserving removal is possible: the equivalence between selected difference constraints and connecting the critical indices is the core mathematical structure of the task. It can only be obscured by re-presenting the same condition in abstract linear-algebra or synchronization language, not removed.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Recognizes the problem as a weighted graph connectivity/Steiner-tree problem and preprocesses edge distances.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: Functionals of the form x_u - x_v and the requirement that all critical coordinates become equal on the joint kernel.

survivor_shortcuts.shortcut: Uses terminal-subset dynamic programming for the weighted Steiner tree.
survivor_shortcuts.affordance: The critical set has at most 10 indices, enabling terminal-mask DP, together with pairwise difference constraints that behave as undirected edges.

common_affordance: The joint kernel condition is exactly equivalent to requiring the selected functional edges to connect all critical indices, i.e. a weighted Steiner-tree problem.

defeated_student_causes.why_failed: Uses a Kruskal/MST-style formulation that does not correctly account for cost-sharing through optional noncritical Steiner vertices.
Treats the task as connecting the critical vertices directly or through an MST-like construction, rather than solving the minimum Steiner tree.

recommended_edit: No single edit can defeat the surviving approaches without changing the task: their shared reduction is intrinsic. A presentational disguise using abstract observability constraints could make recognition harder, but the same Steiner-tree solution remains valid.
regression_risk: A mere wording disguise could accidentally make the problem clearer to the already-defeated MST-based models or restore them if it explicitly mentions graph connectivity.
